name: Perevodnoy Durak
description: Perevodnoy Durak (Transfer Fool) is a Durak variant where the defender can transfer the attack to the next player by playing a card of the same rank. Otherwise like Podkidnoy Durak: 36 cards, attack/defend, last with cards = Fool. Works well with 2 players.

overview.description: Perevodnoy Durak (Transfer Fool) is a Durak variant where the defender can transfer the attack to the next player by playing a card of the same rank. Otherwise like Podkidnoy Durak: 36 cards, attack/defend, last with cards = Fool. Works well with 2 players.

history.origins: Variant of Podkidnoy Durak. 'Perevodnoy' = transfer. Defender passes attack by matching rank.
timeline: See Durak. Transfer variant popular in Russia/Ukraine.
history.evolution: Transfer adds tactical depth. Kiev variation: transfer after beating some cards.

setup.dealing: 6 each. Turn one for trump. Stock face-down.

rules.objective: Get rid of all your cards. The last player holding cards at the end of the game is the Durak (Fool) and loses.
rules.gameplay: As Podkidnoy Durak, except: defender with card of SAME RANK as first attack card can TRANSFER: play it, attack passes to next player with both cards. New defender can add same rank, transfer again. Cannot transfer if new defender has too few cards to defend. Alternative: beat or pick up.
keyRules: Transfer: play equal rank to pass attack to next player.
Transfer adds your card to attack; next must defend or transfer.
Cannot transfer if new defender cannot defend (e.g. only 1 card vs 2-card attack).
Once a card beaten, transfer no longer possible for that bout.
Otherwise as Podkidnoy: attack, defend, throw in, draw to 6.

strategy.basic: Transfer when defender has few cards. Beat with trump to stop transfer.
strategy.intermediate: Lead two of same rank to block transfer. Save equal ranks for transfer.
strategy.advanced: Endgame: force opponent to pick up. Transfer to exhausted player.
tips: Kiev: can transfer after beating first cards, for new thrown-in cards.
Pass card variant: show trump of same rank to transfer without playing it.

variations.name: Kiev
variations.description: After beating some cards, defender can transfer new thrown-in cards by playing equal.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Kiev variant only changes transfer timing; no engine constant overrides identified yet.

variations.name: Pass Card
variations.description: Trump of same rank: show (don't play) to transfer; keep card.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Pass card variant changes transfer mechanic only; no engine overrides needed for base build.

synthesis.shortDescription: Durak with transfer. Match rank to pass attack. 2-6p.
